title: ECMWF warm European winter forecast versus Dutch TTF

source.type: X post with ECMWF seasonal forecast map
source.visible_claim: Hot winter expected. This is going to make winter TTF trading all the more enjoyable.
source.visible_chart: ECMWF System 5 probabilistic most-likely tercile forecast for DJF 2026/27 2m temperature, initialized 2026-08-01.
limitations: The chart is a probability-category map, not a deterministic temperature forecast.
No exact area-weighted European probability can be recovered from the image alone.
The embedded Polymarket Super El Nino statement is separate and excluded from the signal.

canonical_hypothesis: An August ECMWF forecast assigning at least 60 percent probability to upper-tercile DJF temperatures over a fixed European gas-demand box causes a bearish information shock in the equal-weight Dutch TTF December-January-February strip.
decision: Accept as a candidate and preserve a frozen proposed rule, but block the backtest and any shadow position until machine-readable ECMWF data and point-in-time TTF settlement history are available.
governing_rule: Canonical before enhanced. Source evidence earns research work, not capital rights.
